about_the_game:
The demo gives you a glimpse into the world of Condorra with the first two chapters of the game. Turn-based battles with a timing twist, mysterious environments, and the start to a not so straight forward story. We hope you enjoy it :)

If you encounter any problems, feel free to write us in the steam forums or contact us via email (contact@frameland.net).

  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
